    end as value
from (
    select 
        year(flight_date) as year,

    from turnaround.mart_airport_day
    where airport = 'CLT'
    group by year
) as yearly_delay

        avg(dep_delay_sum) as prev_year_dep_delay_sum
    from turnaround.mart_airport_day

) as prev_year_delay
on yearly_delay.year = prev_year_delay.year
order by value desc

    select 
        sum(deposits) as deposits
